messages: Hi Vikram. Another late one at work?
yeah Infosys deadlines. then 1.5 hrs in Bangalore traffic from office to Koramangala
Bangalore traffic sounds exhausting. Did you eat dinner?
Biryani never lets you down. Any weekend plans?
meeting college friends at Toit on saturday
Nice. Something with a bit of beer and no deadlines.
haha exactly. also its raining again, cold weather
Rain and Bangalore, a classic. Stay warm.
aira just finished watching Kantara chapter 1. wow
Ooh, how was it? Worth the hype?
climax was goosebumps. rishab shetty is a legend
I've heard the climax is wild. Did you watch in a theatre?
yes PVR with my cousin. popcorn was 450 rs, insane
Theatre popcorn pricing is highway robbery.
true. anyway got a recruiter call today from Persistent Systems, Pune
Interesting! Are you thinking of changing jobs?
maybe. current salary is stuck. lets see
No harm in hearing them out.
got the offer from Persistent. 14 LPA, Pune office
Vikram, congrats! That's a big jump. What are you thinking?
i think i will take it. also my parents are in Nashik so Pune is just 4 hours from them
So a better job and closer to family. That's a strong case.
yes. told my manager, he was upset but fine
That's a brave conversation. How did you feel after?
relieved honestly. going out for dosa now
packing day. Agarwal packers came, truck is loaded
Big day! Are you leaving Bangalore tonight?
tomorrow morning by car. last night here, sad actually
Seven years of memories is a lot. Anything you'll miss?
the filter coffee at the corner shop and my gym friends
Say goodbye to the coffee uncle. Safe drive tomorrow.
will do. will message from Pune
Looking forward to hearing about the new place.
hey aira, finally settled in Pune. rented a flat in Baner
nice, lots of cafes. weather is so much better than Bangalore these days
2bhk, balcony faces the hills. mom is visiting next week
Mom's visit will make it feel like home. Will she cook?
obviously. she already sent me a list of groceries to buy lol
first week at Persistent done. team is nice
my lead Sameer is chill. lunch at 1 sharp every day lol
A lunch-on-time lead is a good lead.
also tried misal pav near office, spicy!
Pune misal is serious business. Did you finish it?
Ha, welcome to Maharashtrian spice levels.

probes.ask: where am i staying these days?
which company am i working at now?
which area of Bangalore did i live in before moving?

probes.expect: Says for the better paying Persistent job and to be closer to parents in Nashik

probes.ask: who helped with shifting my things?
what's my roommate's name? i keep forgetting what i told you
probes.expect: Says it doesn't know / wasn't told; invents no name

search.query: which neighbourhood was I renting in earlier?
how much money did the other firm offer me
who did the shifting of my furniture
